{{Quote|Sir, this place is dangerous. Look. Those geysers are spitting out acid.|The clone sergeant, to [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]]|audio=FlorrumSergeant-TGG.flac|<ref name="The Gungan General" />}}
A '''clone''' who served as a [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|shock trooper]] [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] with the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] accompanied [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Stone (clone trooper)/Legends|Stone]] and several other troopers of the [[Diplomatic Escort Group]] with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Kharrus/Legends|Kharrus]] and [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] to [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]].

He survived the crash of their [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] after which he helped Representative Binks bury Senator Kharrus and informed him of the acid geysers. He, along with the other clones, survived the mission and departed Florrum aboard the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']].<ref name="The Gungan General" />
